errors.evidence: The Y-axis has no numerical labels. The description fabricates these labels and their intervals.

In the description of the orange line ('2 По-скоро съгласен'), the starting value is stated as 22%, but the chart shows this line starting much lower, visually around 13%. The value 22% corresponds to the yellow line ('4 По-скоро несъгласен') at that age group.
The line is grey, but the term 'Сиво-сиво' (Grey-grey) is an awkward and unclear description of the color.

In the description of the yellow line ('4 По-скоро несъгласен'), the starting value is stated as 25%, but the chart shows it starting at 22%. The value 25% corresponds to the dark blue line ('5 Силно несъгласен') at that age group.

In the description of the dark blue line ('5 Силно несъгласен'), the value for the '26-34' age group is stated as 4%, but the chart shows it is 2%. The value 4% corresponds to the grey line ('3 Не мога да преценя') at that point.
The description uses 'Синя линия' (Blue line) for both series '1' and series '5', which are different shades of blue. This creates ambiguity as it doesn't distinguish between the two different lines.
The description states the Y-axis range is from 0% to 64%. This is the range of the data, not the range of the axis itself, which visually extends from below 0% to above 64%.
